capability: Open the sign-in dialog
userAction: Click the 'Sign in' primary button in the navbar
currentResult: AuthModal opens as a centered overlay (z-50) with BodyScrollLock; label t('signInBtn')

capability: Switch UI language (EN <-> RU)
userAction: Click the EN/RU toggle button
currentResult: setLanguage(language === 'en' ? 'ru' : 'en'); only 'en' and 'ru' exist (UI_LANGUAGES); label flips EN/RU, title t('switchLanguage'); all t() strings re-render

capability: Toggle light/dark theme
userAction: Click the moon/sun icon button
currentResult: Document theme flips; button title switches between t('switchToDark') and t('switchToLight'); icons Moon (light) / Sun (dark)

capability: Open/close the mobile navigation menu
userAction: Click the hamburger / X icon
currentResult: AnimatePresence panel with theme, language and sign-in rows; max-h calc(100dvh - --app-navbar-height), overflow-y-auto

capability: View rotating hero slides with resort copy
userAction: Land on the page and wait; or swipe the hero horizontally on touch
commandOrReadModel: readModel: subscribeResortConfig -> resortConfig.slides (CustomHeroSlide[]), fallback FALLBACK_SLIDES from src/features/admin
currentResult: Slides render line1En/line1Ru eyebrow + line2En/line2Ru heading; line3* is NOT rendered. Autoplay every resortConfig.slideIntervalSeconds (default 6, useResortStats default 8); HERO_CROSSFADE_MS=1400; random order when slidesRandomOrder

capability: Hero CTA - start your journey (scroll to instructors)
userAction: Click the primary hero button t('startYourJourney')
currentResult: onScrollToSection('coaches-grid') smooth-scrolls the instructor list into view

capability: Hero CTA - choose a course (scroll to group courses)
userAction: Click the secondary hero link t('chooseCourse')
currentResult: onScrollToSection('courses-grid') smooth-scrolls the course grid into view

capability: Advance hero slide from the mobile pagination control
userAction: Tap the 'NN / MM' pagination button
currentResult: Advances to the next slide; aria-label = t('goToSlide') + ' i / n'. No keyboard arrow-key support and no per-slide dot navigation

capability: Explore the public skill-path / achievement teaser
userAction: Scroll to the journey band; hover or select a level marker
currentResult: Guest sees eyebrow journeyEyebrow, title journeyTitle, journeyDesc1/2, 4-level wavy path, per-level skill cards and AchievementGrid. No XP marker, no streak, no 'continue development' link for guests

capability: View live resort weather / snow / wind / lifts
userAction: Read the sidebar while scrolling the home page
states: falls back to defaults on fetch failure
currentResult: Resort name (nameRu/nameEn), temperature AnimatedNumber, weather label t(getWeatherConditionKey(weatherCode)), snowCover + cm, windSpeed + km/h, lifts open/closed (t('openToday')/t('closedToday')). NO loading state, NO error state, NO lastUpdated display: on fetch failure useResortStats silently substitutes -5C/175cm/15kmh/12 lifts

capability: Toggle Celsius / Fahrenheit
userAction: Click the big temperature number
currentResult: Temperature re-renders as F (tempC*9/5+32) or C; aria-label t('mountainTemp')

capability: Browse group courses
userAction: Scroll to the 'Intensive group courses' section (#courses-grid)
currentResult: Responsive grid of GroupCourseCard sorted by sortVisibleCourses (isHidden filtered, order then title); staggered whileInView entry animation; empty state .ui-empty-state + t('noIntensiveCoursesAvailable')

capability: See course price, level, schedule and duration
userAction: Read a course card
currentResult: Price rendered via CurrencyContext.formatPrice (KZT, ru-RU locale + '₸') with t('perCourse'); level badge; date chip; duration chip; description; badge image/text

capability: Read the course enrollment CTA state
userAction: Read the primary card button
currentResult: Label set is exactly enrolled|awaitingPayment|accessSuspended|soldOut|unavailable|enroll. enrollDisabled when enrolled, isClientActive===false, isFull, isCapacityFrozen, or !isEnrollmentEligible. Guests with an active enrollment get a clickable t('guestCheckStatus')

capability: Start course enrollment (opens auth-gated enrollment modal)
userAction: Click the primary card CTA
currentResult: CourseEnrollmentModal opens. Login is NOT required to continue: the modal offers a guest/auth slider

capability: Open course details
userAction: Click the 'Details' (t('courseDetails')) button
currentResult: CourseDetailsModal opens with program, benefits, gallery, video, instructors, static review placeholders, FAQ accordion, seats bar and enroll CTA

capability: Expand a course FAQ item
userAction: Click a FAQ row
currentResult: One item expanded at a time (expandedFaq state); t('courseFaqTitle') heading. There is no site-wide public FAQ page

capability: Browse available instructors
userAction: Scroll to 'Meet our guides'
currentResult: useInstructorFilters always excludes !instructor.isAvailable on the public list. Rows are InstructorCard with avatar, name, bio, specialty+experience chip, spoken languages, rating and hourly price

capability: Filter instructors (search / discipline / language / sort)
userAction: Type in search, tap discipline chips, pick language, pick sort order
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useUiStore (searchQuery, selectedSpecialty, selectedLanguage, sortBy) - in-memory, not persisted
currentResult: Discipline all|ski|snowboard|both; language all|en|de|fr|ru|it|es; sort rating|priceAsc|priceDesc|experience. Filters skipped entirely when filtersEnabled is false. resetFilters clears query/specialty/language but NOT sortBy

capability: Reset instructor filters
userAction: Click t('resetFilters')
currentResult: Clears searchQuery, selectedSpecialty, selectedLanguage; the instructor list repopulates (sortBy survives)

capability: Book an instructor (opens the booking modal)
userAction: Click t('bookNow')
currentResult: BookingModal opens with the guest/auth slider; header shows instructor + hourly rate + t('privateInstruction')

capability: Read public instructor reviews
userAction: Click the star rating / t('readReviews')
currentResult: InstructorReviewsModal opens with paginated canonical reviews and a 'load more' control

capability: Switch between guest booking and sign-in inside the booking modal
userAction: Tap the segmented switch (t('guestBookingTab') / t('authTab'))
currentResult: guest shows GuestBookingForm; auth shows an inline <Auth/> with t('bookingSignInPrompt'). Login is OPTIONAL - the guest path never requires an account. aria-label of the tablist is hardcoded Russian 'Режим записи'

capability: Fill the guest lesson reservation form
userAction: Type name, phone, optional email, goals/notes; pick date/time/duration/stage
commandOrReadModel: readModel: queryInstructorOccupancyReadModels({scope:'public_instructor_day'}) for the selected and next day
currentResult: Required: guestNameLabel, guestPhoneLabel, date. Optional: guestEmailLabel, personalGoalsNotes. Selectors: selectDate, timeSlot (wheel picker over available slots), durationHours [1,2,3,4,6], lessonStage (beginner|intermediate|advanced|freeride|freestyle). Total t('totalLessonFee') = rate x duration

capability: Submit a guest lesson reservation request
userAction: Click t('submitGuestApplication')
currentResult: Guest participant derived via deriveGuestParticipantIdForBooking; guestDiscipline 'ski', guestAgeYears 25. Credential persisted (rememberGuestReservation). guest_reservation_limit shows GuestReservationLimitAlert; other errors toast t('bookingError')

capability: Look up a previous guest reservation for this instructor
userAction: Click t('guestCheckPreviousStatus') when a remembered reservation exists
commandOrReadModel: readModel: loadGuestSingleLessonBooking(bookingId) with stored guest credential
currentResult: Switches the modal to GuestReservationStatus. Unusable credentials are forgotten via forgetGuestReservation; other errors stay recoverable

capability: Track the lifecycle of a guest lesson reservation
userAction: Read the status panel; click t('guestCheckStatus') to refresh
currentResult: role='status'. Shows hold deadline, price, outstanding amount, and whether payment was received. t('guestCheckStatus') / t('processing') while refreshing; t('guestStatusRefreshFailed') on read error. Amounts use Intl + '₸' (RU) or 'KZT' (EN), bypassing CurrencyContext

capability: Cancel a pending guest lesson reservation
userAction: Click t('guestCancelPending'), then confirm
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'request_booking_cancellation' (guest variant) with guestActionNonce/guestActionSignature, exercisedCapability 'account_owner', idempotency deriveCancellationIdempotencyKey
currentResult: Eligibility requires statusHydrated && lifecycle 'pending' && payment.unpaidCancellationEligible && deadline not passed. Two-step inline confirm. After cancel the local lifecycle is patched and a read verifies the revision advanced, otherwise t('cabinetCancellationRefreshWarning')

capability: Fill and submit a guest group-course application
userAction: Type name*, phone*, optional email and notes; click t('submitGuestCourseApplication')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'create_course_enrollments' (guest variant) via executeGuestCanonicalCommand; idempotency deriveGuestCreateEnrollmentIdempotencyKey
currentResult: Guest participant resolveGuestCourseSessionParticipantId(); guestSkillLevel 'beginner', guestDiscipline 'ski', guestAgeYears 25. Course totals shown as t('courseTotalTuition') + course.dates. Button reflects courseAwaitingPayment / courseEnrolled / submitGuestCourseApplication

capability: Sign up / sign in inline while enrolling
userAction: Switch to the auth tab and submit credentials
commandOrReadModel: command: signUpWithEmailService / signInWithEmailService / signInWithGoogleService via Auth
currentResult: On success setAuthenticatedProfile + resetSelection and the modal switches to the authenticated participant-picker form

capability: Register a new account with avatar selection
userAction: Click t('noAccount'), fill display name / phone / email / password, pick an avatar, submit t('signUpBtn')
currentResult: Validation: authDisplayNameRequired and regex /^[a-zA-Zа-яА-ЯёЁ\s\-'\u00C0-\u017F]+$/ (authNameCharactersOnly). Avatar presets Felix/Aneka/Jack/Buster/Bella/Luna + dice randomize + free-text seed (DiceBear adventurer SVG). Success toast authWelcomeAcademy/authRegisteredCredits

capability: Sign in with email and password
userAction: Enter email/password and click t('signInBtn')
currentResult: Authenticated uid is authoritative. Error mapping: authEmailInUse / authWeakPassword / authInvalidCredential / authOperationNotAllowed / authNetworkError. Falls back to a profile with displayName 'Alpine Glider' and toast authProfileSetup when no profile exists

capability: Sign in with Google
userAction: Click the Google button (t('googleSignIn'))
currentResult: auth/popup-blocked -> authPopupBlocked; network -> authNetworkError; auth/popup-closed-by-user is ignored entirely. Success toasts authGoogleLinkedCredits or authGoogleProfileFound/authLinkedToName

capability: Request a password recovery email
userAction: Click 'Forgot password', enter the email, click t('authSendRecoveryLink')
currentResult: Success toast authResetEmailSent with authResetEmailPrefix/Suffix and returns to the login view; auth/user-not-found -> authUserNotFound; t('authBackToLogin') returns

capability: Receive transient feedback toasts
userAction: Perform any action that calls addNotification(type, title, message)
commandOrReadModel: readModel: none (in-memory useState; max 10 kept, 4 visible, auto-dismiss 6000ms)
currentResult: Fixed bottom-left/bottom-right stack, per-type icon and border colour, manual close button. No role/aria-live is set, so screen readers are not notified

capability: Read the site footer and dismiss the Firestore error banner
userAction: Scroll to the footer; click the 'x' on the amber banner
states: footer hidden below 1200px on non-home routes
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useUiStore.dbStatusWarning set from registerFirestoreErrorListener in AppBootstrap
currentResult: Footer has NO links (only '© {year} Carve Academy' and a hardcoded English 'Ski & Snowboard Instruction'). Banner text is t('dbRestricted') + operation + path

capability: Enter the student cabinet (auth gate)
userAction: Navigate to /cabinet or any /cabinet/:tab while signed in
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useProfileStore.userProfile, useAuthStore.authLoading/profileLoading; validated against CABINET_TABS
currentResult: AuthRoute gate; invalid tab ids redirect to /cabinet; cabinet content lazy-loads behind CabinetLoadingFallback (Skeleton + CardSkeleton)

capability: Suspended-client lock screen
userAction: Sign in with an account where isClientActive === false
currentResult: The entire cabinet is replaced by a lock card with t('accessSuspended') + t('accessSuspendedDesc'); no cabinet functionality is reachable

capability: Switch cabinet bottom tabs
userAction: Tap home / training / coach / settings, or swipe left-right between tabs
commandOrReadModel: readModel: URL param :tab via parseCabinetTabParam; navigation writes /cabinet/<tab>
currentResult: 4 tabs: home (scNavHome), training (scNavTraining), coach (scNavCoach), settings (scNavProfile). Deep links collapse onto the parent tab via resolveStudentBottomNavTab. Swipe is touch-only (>=35px, <800ms, horizontal-dominant, ignores inputs/overlays/horizontal scrollers)

capability: Open the instructor picker from the floating Book button
userAction: Tap the green CalendarPlus FAB (t('bookNow'))
currentResult: BookInstructorPickerModal opens (bottom sheet, role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby). Swiping from the last tab also opens it

capability: See the wallet balance
userAction: Read the balance chip in the navbar
currentResult: Formatted with CurrencyContext.formatPrice (KZT, ru-RU + '₸'); data-testid navbar-balance / navbar-balance-mobile. No top-up control is reachable from the navbar

capability: Switch workspace between cabinet and instructor
userAction: Click the workspace pill, then a menu item
commandOrReadModel: readModel: location.pathname active state; workspaceItems from isInstructorWorkspaceUser
currentResult: role=menu/menuitem links to /cabinet (clientCabinet) and /instructor (instructorWorkspaceTab); closes on outside pointerdown, route change, or selection; position synced to the trigger on resize/scroll

capability: Switch the active Participant
userAction: Click a participant avatar
currentResult: Buttons carry aria-label 'Switch to participant {name}', aria-pressed, aria-current, data-participant-id. interactive = items.length > 1. Empty list renders a synthetic 'fallback' avatar from userProfile. Selection is shared with the cabinet via one in-memory zustand store (NOT persisted)

capability: Open the notification hub and see the unread badge
userAction: Click the bell icon
currentResult: Opens NotificationHubModal and immediately calls handleMarkNotificationsAsRead(). Badge = Firestore unread + unreviewed completed lessons

capability: Review, delete and clear notifications
userAction: Read the hub; click the per-item X, t('clearHistory'), or 'Load more notifications'
commandOrReadModel: readModel: onSnapshot on 'notifications' where userId == uid, orderBy timestamp desc, paged by notificationsPageSize; expired docs filtered by notificationRetentionDays
currentResult: Also contains a 'Rate completed lessons' block (rateCompletedLessons) with reviewAction (scrolls and clicks #notify-review-btn-<id>) and a per-row dismiss (hide). Sync hook purges expired notifications on session start and toasts newly added docs younger than 15s

capability: Sign out of the account
userAction: Click the logout icon or t('signOutAccount')
currentResult: Navigate('/') + toast loggedOut/loggedOutDesc; the participant selection store resets to EMPTY_STATE

capability: View personal journey / level / XP
userAction: Scroll the top of the cabinet
currentResult: YourJourneySection with fillViewport and animateSequence=false; TrainingStreak shows XP to next level; the guest-only AchievementGrid is not shown; onOpenDevelopment wires t('scContinueDevelopment') to the development tab

capability: See today's sessions, countdown, tasks, next step and next sessions
userAction: Read the 'Today' section; open a session, toggle a task, add a custom task, or open the next session
commandOrReadModel: readModel: filterCabinetCourseDaysForParticipant(sessionItems, selectedParticipantId) via getCurrentSessions / getNextSessionsNext7DaysFromSessions / getMiniCalendarDaysFromSessions / hasTrainingTodayFromSessions
currentResult: Includes CurrentSessionsBlock, SessionCountdownBlock, TodayTasksBlock, StudentNextStepCard, NextSessionBlock (mini calendar) and TodayProgressBlock. Buttons open sessions (chat), lessons, and course details

capability: Complete, add and remove 'today' tasks (skills + trainer recommendations)
userAction: Tick a task; add a custom task; remove a task; start an exercise (auto-pins the skill)
commandOrReadModel: readModel/writeModel: handleToggleTodayTaskComplete, handleAddCustomTodayTask, handleRemoveTodayTask, handleToggleSkillToday, handlePinSkillsToday -> all route through profileStore.handleUpdateProfile (updateUserProfileService); trainer recommendations via togglePresentedParticipantLessonFeedbackItem
currentResult: Helper builders buildToggleTodayCompleteUpdate / buildAddCustomTodayTaskUpdate / buildRemoveTodayTaskUpdate / buildToggleSkillTodayUpdate / buildPinSkillsTodayUpdate in src/features/student-cabinet/todayChecklist.ts. Recommendation toggle failures are silently swallowed. Pinning shows t('scRadarTasksAddedTitle') with the added skill titles

capability: See pending review and pending trainer-feedback prompts
userAction: Read up to 5 rows; click t('writeReviewBtn'), t('scDismissReviewPrompt') or t('scHistoryOpenRecommendations')
currentResult: Rows are sorted by dateLabel desc and capped at 5. Dismiss writes to localStorage['alpine_glide_dismissed_reviews_<uid>'] and calls dismissReviewService

capability: See resort conditions inside the cabinet (only on training days)
userAction: Read the weather block; click the temperature to toggle units
states: hidden (no session today or no resortSnapshot)
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useResortStats snapshot passed down from CabinetRouteContainer resortSnapshot prop
currentResult: Rendered only when currentSessions.length > 0 || hasTrainingTodayFromSessions(sessionItems); same data as the public sidebar (no loading/error state)

capability: Browse sessions on a month calendar and filter by day
userAction: Click previous/next month; click a day with sessions; clear the day filter
states: no sessions on the selected day
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useAccountLessonBookingCalendarMonth({ enabled, year, monthIndex }) + resolveInitialVisibleAccountCalendarMonth / shiftVisibleAccountCalendarMonth
currentResult: Course days render violet, lessons accent, each with a dot; clicking toggles a date filter (t('showingLessonsFor') + t('showAll')). Scope chips upcoming|current|past|all. hideCancelled ToggleSwitch persists to localStorage['alpine_glide_hide_cancelled_bookings'] and only appears when cancelled/withdrawn sessions exist. Pagination 5/page

capability: Inspect an upcoming/past lesson row (status, fee, participants)
userAction: Read the row
commandOrReadModel: readModel: LessonBookingCabinetItem (status, cancellationReason, participantNames, instructor, lifecycle) + resolveLessonBookingPaymentDisplay / lessonBookingPaymentDisplayLabel
currentResult: Shows instructor avatar/name, LessonFeedbackIndicator, difficulty + duration (hrSession), participant line, date/time chips, total fee label, StatusBadge, and a cancellation reason line when status is pending_cancellation

capability: Open the lesson chat
userAction: Click t('chat')
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useBookingChatUnread(uid, bookings) -> hasUnreadChat / markBookingChatRead; writeModel: createChatMessage via BookingChatModal
currentResult: Opens BookingChatModal (lazy, ui-modal-overlay fallback) with chat, homework panel and media uploader. Guests cannot reach it

capability: Open lesson details, recommendations and the write-review entry
userAction: Click t('scMoreDetails') on a lesson row
currentResult: LessonDetailsModal (role=dialog, aria-modal) shows difficulty, date, instructor, StudentOpenChangeRequestNotice, the feedback checklist, and t('writeReviewBtn') when status is completed and unreviewed

capability: Request a lesson cancellation
userAction: Click cancel on a lesson, then confirm in the dialog
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'request_booking_cancellation' (authenticated) with expectedRevision, idempotency deriveCancellationIdempotencyKey(bookingId, revision), exercisedCapability from resolveLessonBookingClientExercisedCapability
currentResult: ConfirmActionModal shows t('cancelConfirmMessage') + instructor + t('cancelConfirmSuffix'); no reason is collected on this path. Outcome toasts from presentCabinetCancellationNotifications; on shouldRefresh it refetches account_hot and warns; errors rethrow so the confirm stays open. Post-command refresh is account_hot only, except on /cabinet/history and /cabinet/profile_journey (hot + account_history) via resolveLessonBookingCommandRefreshStrategy

capability: Reschedule a lesson (new date/time)
userAction: Click reschedule; pick a date and an available time; confirm
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'reschedule_booking' via useCustomerBookingCollaboration; readModel: useRescheduleBookingAvailability (public_instructor_day, excludes the current booking)
currentResult: Date BookingAppleDatePicker (t('selectDate')) + time BookingAppleWheelPicker (t('collabSelectTime')); confirm label copy.rescheduleConfirm. The dialog has no role='dialog' and no Escape handling

capability: Withdraw a pending cancellation request
userAction: Click withdraw on a lesson with a pending cancellation
currentResult: Row reverts to its normal lifecycle after the refetch; a submitting id disables the row buttons

capability: Accept or decline a trainer-initiated booking proposal
userAction: Click accept or decline on an open proposal
currentResult: Shows instructor, participant, date, time, duration and copy.proposalOpenLabel; buttons gated by proposal.authorizedActions.canAccept / canDecline

capability: Open course details from a course day
userAction: Click t('scMoreDetails') on a group-course session
currentResult: CourseDetailsModal opens with the participant-scoped enrollment, progress summary and withdraw/cancel-aware actions

capability: Request cancellation of a course enrollment
userAction: Click t('requestCourseCancellation'), then confirm
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'request_course_enrollment_cancellation' with expectedRevision, idempotency deriveRequestCancellationIdempotencyKey, exercisedCapability 'account_owner'
currentResult: Confirm text t('courseCancelConfirmMessage'); outcomes presented via presentCabinetCancellationNotifications('course', ...); shouldRefresh triggers refetchAccountHotEnrollments + warning toast

capability: Withdraw a course enrollment
userAction: Click t('collabWithdrawCancellation')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'withdraw_course_enrollment' with idempotency deriveWithdrawEnrollmentIdempotencyKey, exercisedCapability 'account_owner'
currentResult: Runs without a confirm dialog; success toast courseCancellationWithdrawn / courseCancellationWithdrawnDesc

capability: Browse my courses and enroll in new ones
userAction: Read 'My courses' / 'Available courses'; click enroll on a card
currentResult: Two grids of GroupCourseCard; the card CTA resolves to the same enrolled/awaitingPayment/soldOut/unavailable labels and opens CourseEnrollmentModal on the authenticated path. Empty states per section

capability: Enroll one or more participants in a course
userAction: Select participants in the picker and click t('enroll')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'create_course_enrollments' (authenticated) with participantIds[] and exercisedCapability from resolveSelectedParticipantCommand; idempotency deriveAuthenticatedCreateEnrollmentIdempotencyKey(courseId, participantIds)
currentResult: COURSE_ENROLLMENT_SELECTION_MAX = 8. Debit is optimistic via withOptimisticBalance(-course.price) and is REVERTED when the server returns outcome 'already_exists'. Confetti (150) on success; refreshFailed -> postCreateRefreshFailed*; already enrolled -> warning

capability: Select participants for a booking / enrollment
userAction: Tap participant chips
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useManagedParticipants; pure logic resolveEffectiveParticipantIds / toggleParticipantSelection / requiresExplicitParticipantSelection in src/features/participants/participantSelectionState.ts
currentResult: A sole participant is auto-selected and the picker is hidden. Stale ids are filtered against the current read model. The optional onCreateDependent prop is never passed - dependents can only be created from the Participants tab

capability: See level progress, radar of skills and priority exercises
userAction: Read the progress bar and radar; toggle t('scAddToToday') / t('scRemoveFromToday') on a priority exercise
commandOrReadModel: readModel: getLevelProgressPercent / getPrioritySkillItems / calculateSkillProgress + settingsStore.skillConfig; writeModel: onToggleSkillToday -> profileStore.handleToggleSkillToday
currentResult: ScProgressBar (role=progressbar, aria-valuenow) + t('scPointsToNextLevel'); LazySkillRadarChart (full, with pin support); last skill_scores_updated entry from activityLogs with instructor name and points delta

capability: View my instructors and drill into coach chat / videos / comments / homework / recommendations
userAction: Pick an instructor, then pick a sub-view
currentResult: Same component also serves /cabinet/instructors (alias deep link). Sub-view labels: scCoachChat/scCoachChatSub, scCoachVideoReviews, scCoachComments, scCoachHomework, scRecommendations. ParticipantLessonFeedbackList is rendered for the selected instructor

capability: Book an instructor from the grouped picker
userAction: Tap an instructor row, or tap t('scBrowseCourses')
commandOrReadModel: readModel: getInstructorPickerGroups(userProfile, bookings, instructors); selection -> uiStore.setSelectedInstructor -> BookingModal
currentResult: Groups are translated with translateInstructor; rows show rating (or instructorNoReviews) and price/hr. Browse-courses navigates to the courses tab and closes

capability: Book a lesson for one or more participants
userAction: Pick date/time/duration/stage, select participants, add notes, click t('payConfirmLesson')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'create_confirmed_booking' with participantIds[] and exercisedCapability from deriveExercisedCapabilityFromParticipants ('parent_guardian' if any dependent else 'account_owner'); idempotency deriveAuthenticatedCreateIdempotencyKey
currentResult: Pricing from queryLessonPricingSettingsReadModel (additionalParticipantSurchargePerHourKzt, maxParticipantsPerLesson). totalCost = rate x duration + round(surcharge x max(0, n-1) x duration). Confetti (100) on success. Two guards render HARDCODED RU/EN strings instead of translation keys

capability: Rate and review an instructor after a completed lesson
userAction: Click t('writeReviewBtn'); choose 1-5 stars; type a comment; click t('postInstructorReview')
commandOrReadModel: command: createCanonicalInstructorReview({ accountId, bookingId, rating, comment, exercisedCapability })
currentResult: Comment maxLength = INSTRUCTOR_REVIEW_COMMENT_MAX_LENGTH. exercisedCapability is resolved from the booking via resolveLessonBookingClientExercisedCapability; if unresolvable the submit throws and the user sees reviewFailed/reviewFailedDesc. Success toast reviewShared/reviewSharedDesc

capability: Dismiss the 'rate this lesson' prompt
entryPoint: src/features/student-cabinet/components/student/StudentNeedsAttention.tsx:126-134; also the notification hub row X
userAction: Click t('scDismissReviewPrompt') (or the hub dismiss X)
currentResult: Optimistic local update; the id is removed from StudentNeedsAttention, the notification hub and the navbar unreviewed badge. PersonalCabinet additionally folds in bookings whose review state is not eligible/reviewed

capability: Review wallet operations and balance-after values
userAction: Page through the ledger; click 'Load more transactions'
commandOrReadModel: readModel: buildWalletOperationHistory(userId, bookings, courses, walletLedgerEntries, lang) + useWalletStore.loadMoreWalletLedger (canonical /users/<id>/wallet ledger)
currentResult: 15 rows per page via ApplePagination; credit rows emerald with ArrowDownLeft, debits rose with ArrowUpRight; t('scProfileWalletBalanceAfter'). Amounts use toLocaleString('ru-RU') + ' ₸' directly, NOT CurrencyContext. The 'Load more transactions' label is hardcoded English

capability: Top up the wallet (dead code in this scope)
userAction: n/a - no route, container, or component renders it
commandOrReadModel: readModel: none; onPaymentSuccess callback is never provided; walletService.applyWalletCredit is a TODO stub that only console.warns
currentResult: PRESERVATION RISK: presets 10000/25000/50000/100000 KZT (default 25000) + sandbox card fields + t('authorizeTopUp') exist but are unreachable. There is no working student wallet top-up in the cabinet

capability: List self and dependent participants
userAction: Read the participant list
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useManagedParticipants(accountId) -> queryManagedParticipantPickerReadModels; self first then authority==='parent_guardian'
currentResult: Each row shows avatar, displayName, authority + discipline + skillLevel, and t('participantsManagedByYou'). /cabinet/profile_personal renders this same panel (compatibility alias)

capability: Add a dependent participant
userAction: Click t('participantsCreateDependent'), fill the inline form, click t('saveChanges')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'create_participant' (exercisedCapability 'account_owner') then canonical 'assign_participant_management' with authority 'parent_guardian' (exercisedCapability 'parent_guardian'); ids from deriveDependentParticipantId / deriveDependentManagementId
currentResult: Two sequential commands: if the assign step fails the participant exists but is unmanaged. No cap on the number of dependents in the client. There is no delete-participant control

capability: Edit a participant profile (name, age/birth date, skill level, discipline, instructor comment)
userAction: Click t('participantsEditProfile') on a row, edit fields, click t('saveChanges')
commandOrReadModel: command: canonical 'update_participant_profile' with expectedRevision and capability by authority (account_owner for self, parent_guardian for dependents)
currentResult: Age is a discriminated union: age_years (number input 0-125) or birth_date (date input), toggled by what the read model returns. Only the SELF row exposes the phone field, written through onUpdateProfile -> profileStore.handleUpdateProfile -> updateUserProfileService (a UserProfile projection, not the Participant)

capability: Upload a per-participant avatar
userAction: Click the avatar, pick an image file
commandOrReadModel: writeModel: optimizeProfileImage (src/features/student-cabinet/components/profileImage.ts) -> uploadImage -> Storage path participantAvatarStoragePath(participantId) -> canonical 'update_participant_profile' with avatarUrl
currentResult: Non-image files are rejected via onInvalidFile -> toast t('invalidFile')/t('invalidFileDesc'). Success toast t('profilePhotoChanged'), error t('uploadFailed'). Each Participant keeps an independent avatar; the self avatar falls back to userProfile.avatarUrl when absent

capability: Hide progress tracking
userAction: Toggle the t('scHideProgressTracking') switch
currentResult: Optimistic; reverts on failure. When true, the home radar, development progress, journey marker and level-up celebration are suppressed

capability: See a merged activity/lesson/review timeline preview
userAction: Read the 5 most recent events; click t('scHistoryShowAll')
commandOrReadModel: readModel: buildStudentHistory(userProfile, bookings, courses, reviews, lang, t, activityLogs, dismissedReviewIds, pendingByLessonId) + usePresentedParticipantLessonFeedback
currentResult: StudentHistoryList with filter='all' and limit=5; events carry pending-recommendation flags. Navigation to /cabinet/history triggers the full account_hot + account_history lesson refresh strategy

capability: Browse the full lesson and activity history with filters and pagination
userAction: Change the history filter, open a lesson, write a review, click 'Load more history'
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useLessonBookingStore.requestHistoryPage (account_history) + profileStore.loadMoreActivityLogs, both paged by QUERY_LIMITS
currentResult: Filters (HistoryFilter), groupByMonth, expandedTrainingCards. The 'Load more history' label is hardcoded English. This is one of only two surfaces that pays for the account_history read after a cancellation

capability: View earned achievements for the selected participant
userAction: Read the achievement chips
commandOrReadModel: readModel: usePresentedParticipantAchievements({ selectedParticipantId, language, accountReviews, achievementsConfig, skillConfig }); writeModel: useSelectedParticipantAchievementsRecorder persists per (accountId, participantId)
currentResult: Chips show an icon, label and earnedAtLabel. The evaluation is recorded from canonical review evidence via accountReviewEvidenceFromCanonicalPresentation

capability: View season statistics (lessons, hours, exercises mastered, points)
userAction: Read the stat grid
currentResult: ScStatGrid tinted cards: scLessonsCount, scHoursCount, scExercisesMastered, scPointsEarned; header t('scProfileSeasonYear') with {year}. Lessons/hours show '—' until the stats read resolves

capability: Certificates section (placeholder only)
userAction: Open the section from the profile hub
currentResult: Renders only t('scProfileCertificatesEmpty'). No certificate data, issuing, download or verification exists in this scope

capability: Student videos section (placeholder only)
userAction: Open the section from the profile hub
currentResult: Renders only t('scProfileVideosEmpty'). Trainer video links exist only in the coach panel (scCoachVideoReviews), not here

capability: Level-up celebration
userAction: Level changes automatically; or click the level badge to reopen
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useParticipantProgressStore.byId + overlaySelfParticipantProgress(selfProgressProfile, progressById); previous level tracked in a ref
currentResult: Shows t('newLevelUnlocked'), the badge image from https://storage.yandexcloud.net/carve/level/{light|dark}/{b|w}/{level}.png and t('levelUpCongrats'). Rendered at z-[99999], click-overlay to close. Uses the 'framer-motion'-free plain portal (no motion import) unlike sibling modals

capability: Recover from a participant read-model error
userAction: Read the error banner; click t('retry')
states: error banner with single-mode picker + retry
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useManagedParticipants(props.userProfile.uid) -> error; retry calls reload() which re-runs ensureCanonicalSelfParticipant then the picker read model
currentResult: While the error is present the banner is rendered above the tab content with selectionMode='single' wired to selectParticipant

capability: Deterministic participant selection (self-first, stale-id reconciliation)
userAction: Implicit (runs on every participants refetch) or explicit via the switcher
states: undefined selection is NOT forced back to self
commandOrReadModel: readModel: useCabinetProgressParticipantSelectionStore (zustand, in-memory, accountId-scoped, reset on sign-out/account switch)
currentResult: PRESERVATION RISK: the store is not persisted to localStorage or Firestore, so a page reload always returns a 2+ participant account to self. resolveInitialCabinetProgressParticipantId explicitly never picks participants[0]

capability: Participant-scoped data isolation
userAction: Switch participants from the navbar; observe which panels change
currentResult: Participant-scoped: identity/level/radar/season/achievements/lesson feedback/course days/course enrollments/course CTAs. NOT scoped: the lesson booking rows passed to history and coach panels (participant names are shown per row instead). When 2+ participants exist but none is selected, progress is withheld while bookings/enrollments still render unfiltered

capability: Self-first participant ordering and avatar fallback
userAction: Read the avatar row
states: avatar url resolved or initial letter
currentResult: Self participants are listed first, then dependents in read-model order. The self avatar falls back to legacy userProfile.avatarUrl. With zero items a synthetic 'fallback' item keeps the header from rendering empty

capability: Tick off trainer homework / recommendations for a lesson
userAction: Tap a feedback item
currentResult: Optimistic pending keys in useParticipantLessonFeedbackStore keyed by participantLessonFeedbackItemKey(participantId, lessonBookingId, itemId). ALL failures are silently swallowed (promise .catch(() => undefined)), so a rejected write looks successful until reload

capability: Cross-workspace navigation (client + instructor in one session)
userAction: Open the workspace pill and pick an item
currentResult: Both /cabinet (clientCabinet) and /instructor (instructorWorkspaceTab) are offered to instructors and admins. Admins also get a Settings icon toggling /admin and the home route

screen: Home redirect for authenticated non-admin users
userAction: Sign in and open the site root
currentResult: Signed-in non-admins cannot see the public landing page; they are pushed to getDefaultWorkspacePath. Admins keep the public home plus an admin toggle

capability: Recover from a render crash
userAction: Click 'Try again' in the red fallback panel
commandOrReadModel: readModel: none; logErrorBoundaryFailure writes to the errors feature
currentResult: Red panel with the raw error message and a 'Try again' button that clears the boundary state. Chunk-load errors instead auto-reload via reloadForStaleChunk(). Text is hardcoded English, not translated

capability: KZT-only currency formatting
userAction: Read any price (balances, fees, course prices, instructor rates)
commandOrReadModel: readModel: none (pure formatting); formatPrice(amountKzt, preferredKzt) prefers an explicit KZT value
currentResult: Always KZT; formatKzt uses amount.toLocaleString('ru-RU') + ' ₸' regardless of the UI language. Several screens bypass it and format inline (wallet list, GuestReservationStatus, ApplePagination item labels), so formatting is inconsistent across the surface
